headline: Flag Fighting Shifts to Weathered Expanse as Gutter Cools
war_summary: Weathered Expanse takes the day's freshest honors: six flags changed hands in the two hours before filing, the last logged at the very minute of this edition, Crow's Nest and Spirit Watch the busiest posts, and the two-hour dead reckoned past eleven hundred. Palantine Berm keeps boiling alongside it — four more transfers in two hours around Windburn Landing and Vendett, both armies now losing above a hundred men an hour. Gutter, which blazed overnight, has cooled to a slow burn: four actions in the past two hours after twenty-seven across the day. The Nevish Line's guns slacken, its two-hour toll fallen from near thirteen hundred to under four hundred, though Blackcoat Way and Tomb Father traded hands until shortly after three. Linn Mercy's flags rest since 02:44, yet its casualty rate has multiplied several times over in the last hour. Callahans Passage bleeds on without a single transfer, twelve hundred casualties in two hours. Godcrofts, still the day's busiest ledger at forty-six actions, has now been silent more than sixteen hours, and Marban Hollow's last transfer came before two. The war stands in its 637th day; thirty-four victory towns remain the prize.
